corrections.case_set_charges: Second-degree murder of fellow Panther Louis Talbert Johnson — accidentally killed during the October 23, 1977 armed attack on the Richmond home of a witness against Huey P. Newton — with the jury relying on transferred intent, plus a firearm-use enhancement. Indicted January 29, 1981 (People v. Forbes, A024602).
corrections.case_set_convicted: Yes — second-degree murder by transferred intent, plus firearm use; not merely attempted murder as some later biographies state
corrections.case_set_sentence: Eight years total — six years for second-degree murder plus a consecutive two years for firearm use, imposed September 7, 1983. He served exactly 4 years, 8 months, and 9 days in California custody, principally at Soledad State Prison with part of the term at San Quentin, and was released in 1985.
desc_replace: served about four and a half years in California prisons
served four years, eight months, and nine days in California prisons — principally Soledad, with part of the term at San Quentin
corrections.append: The custody chronology, assembled from the appellate record (People v. Forbes, 175 Cal. App. 3d 807, case A024602), a Colorado College biography prepared for his 2016 lecture, and his own account: he surrendered around October 1980 after three years underground, was indicted January 29, 1981, and was sentenced September 7, 1983 to six years for second-degree murder plus a consecutive two years for firearm use. The conviction was specifically for the killing of fellow Panther Louis Talbert Johnson under transferred intent — not attempted murder, as some later biographies state. He served exactly four years, eight months, and nine days, which — if his recollection of an October 1980 surrender is right — places his release between June 10 and July 9, 1985; the exact admission and release dates await his CDCR External Movement History, and only the year is entered until that record is located.
corrections.note: Dates deliberately partial: incarceration October 1980 (month precision), release 1985 (year precision); 1713 days is the 4y-8m-9d duration reckoned from October 1. Exact endpoints await the CDCR record.
